description: ci/dagger.json is deliberately NOT managed here. Its engineVersion is a compatibility FLOOR, not a pin: Dagger rejects a module only when engineVersion is NEWER than the running engine (engine.CheckMaxVersionCompatibility -> 'module requires dagger vX, but you have vY'). Raising it buys nothing and can only break CI, which is exactly what happened in #445.
Raise engineVersion by hand, and only when the module actually needs a newer engine — after the engine itself has been bumped.

Dagger is lock-stepped with the engine, which Renovate cannot reach: the engine tag is pinned by Ansible in guettli/gitops (ansible/p16/systemd/system/dagger-engine.service) and CI talks to it over an SSH tunnel. A Dagger PR therefore stays red until that host is bumped and dagger-engine restarted.

Never automerge, and keep every in-repo CLI pin in ONE PR so it is at least internally consistent. Landing it is a two-repo operation: merge the engine bump in gitops first, then this. See DAGGER.md and guettli/gitops#112.

customManagers.description: Dagger CLI baked into the local dev container. A deployment pin: must equal the engine version.

Dagger CLI baked into the sharedinbox-arc CI runner image. A deployment pin: must equal the engine version. Without this manager Renovate moved the other pins and left this one behind, producing a PR that could not pass its own check_dagger_versions.sh.
Engine tag in the example systemd unit in DAGGER.md. A deployment pin: must equal the engine version.
